# colincode.org

> colin: a coding agent in a Luxor sandbox, one command away. The box is
> created or woken for you, the agent runs in tmux, and you pick where it
> thinks: the agent's own sign-in or an inference provider of yours.

colin is one bash script around the Luxor CLI (the `tenki` command; Luxor is
tenki.cloud's new name). An "agent" is a name + harness + inference provider
(+ model). Each agent has its own Luxor sandbox named after it.

Harnesses (26): terminal agents claude, codex, opencode, copilot, gemini, qwen,
crush, goose, kimi, omp, adal, hermes, openclaw; Luxor's own images pi, droid,
grok, amp, prime-agent, tinyfish, anchor, hotdata (the box is created from the
image; tinyfish, anchor and hotdata are toolkits whose `run --` passes raw CLI
arguments); web UIs opencode-web, open-webui, hermes-web, openclaw-web,
durable-pi (served from the box; `colin <agent>` opens an ssh tunnel and your
browser). Creating an agent asks terminal-or-web first, then the harness.

Boxes pause by themselves two hours after they start or wake (Luxor's cap on
max-duration; the CLI has no idle timeout). Every colin command wakes a paused
box. COLINCODE_STICKY=1 makes boxes that never pause by themselves. New boxes
start from a golden image (Luxor base + tmux), found or built on first use. A
persistent volume at ~/work outlives the box; `rm` keeps it and `colin <name>`
brings the agent back on it.

## Install

    curl -fsSL https://colincode.org/install.sh | sh
    tenki login
    colin

Requires the Luxor CLI (https://luxor.ai) and jq. The raw script is served at
https://colincode.org/colin.

## Commands

    colin                       pick an agent (or create one) and jump into it
    colin new [cli|web|harness] create: terminal or web -> harness -> provider -> model -> size -> volume -> name
    colin <harness> [action]    your agent for that harness, or a new one
    colin <agent> [action]      a specific agent by name (a kept volume's name revives it)

    up (default)    create or resume the box, start the agent, attach
    ssh             same as up
    shell           plain shell in the box
    run -- <p>      one-shot headless prompt
    status          agent, provider, box state
    provider        switch inference provider (and model)
    model [id]      switch model
    size [name]     small 2vCPU/4GiB, medium 4/8 (default), large 8/16, xlarge 12/32,
                    xxlarge 16/64; applies when the box is (re)created
    volume [GiB]    persistent volume at ~/work: 10, 25 or 50 GiB, or none; fixed size for life
    url [off]       a public Luxor preview link: the web UI, or for a terminal agent a browser
                    terminal (ttyd) behind a per-agent password; anyone with the link gets in
    auth            sign in, or store or replace the provider key
    down | pause    pause the box (woken by the next command)
    rm | stop | kill   terminate the box and forget the agent; the volume is kept
                    (--purge deletes it)

    colin ls                    agents, their boxes, and kept volumes
    colin volumes [rm <name|id>] every volume in the workspace; delete one (confirmed by name)
    colin config [<name> <value> | unset <name> | edit]   settings and keys; saved defaults
    colin auth [provider]       store or replace a provider API key
    colin image [build [--full] [--public] | forget]   the golden image new boxes start from
    colin pause --all · colin rm --all [--purge]

## Providers

Each harness's own default: Anthropic for claude (sign in inside the box; the
only provider with Remote Control from claude.ai/code), OpenAI for codex, GitHub
for copilot, Google for gemini, Qwen, Moonshot for kimi, Factory for droid, xAI
for grok, Amp, Prime Intellect for prime-agent, and the toolkits' own keys
(TINYFISH_API_KEY, ANCHOR_API_KEY, HOTDATA_API_KEY). Gemini CLI and AdaL take
only their own.

Bring your own models: Nebius Token Factory (NEBIUS_API_KEY), Boundless
(BOUNDLESS_API_KEY), Baseten (BASETEN_API_KEY), Friendli (FRIENDLI_TOKEN),
OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), for every harness that takes a custom endpoint.
The provider is written into the harness's own config inside the box, which
also puts that harness in its no-approval mode. Claude Code loses Remote Control
on any third-party base URL. Nebius has no Anthropic Messages API, so for Claude
Code colin runs a stdlib-only Python translation proxy inside the box (tmux
session claude-proxy, 127.0.0.1:8787, port via COLINCODE_PROXY_PORT). Default
models: Kimi K3 (Nebius, Baseten), Claude Fable 5.1 (Boundless, OpenRouter),
GLM 5.3 (Friendli). Keys live in ~/.config/colincode/env, mode 0600, with the
saved settings.

## Configuration

Saved with `colin config <name> <value>`, or set in the environment for one run:
COLINCODE_HARNESS (claude), COLINCODE_SIZE (medium), COLINCODE_VOLUME_GB (10),
COLINCODE_CPU / COLINCODE_MEMORY_MB (from the size), COLINCODE_DISK_GB (20),
COLINCODE_IMAGE (the golden image), COLINCODE_BASE_IMAGE, COLINCODE_RESUME_TIMEOUT
(3m), COLINCODE_MAX_DURATION (2h, the cap), COLINCODE_PAUSE_RETENTION (720h),
COLINCODE_STICKY (0), COLINCODE_PROXY_PORT (8787).
